subject: selectInput in renderUI not storing the selected value

messages.author: 9070833c3f047422
messages.subject: selectInput in renderUI not storing the selected value
parts:
I am using renderUI in server for displaying selectInput() function in UI. Based on the value i select using selecInput, i want a table to get displayed. The following is my code for the same:

SERVER:

output$director_name <- renderUI({
    selectInput("dir_sel","Director", choices = director_name_list, width = "87%")
})

output$table1 <- renderDataTable({
    url1 <- paste0("http://wwwin-csap.cisco.com/cgi-bin/ws_geDEManagerList.cgi?directorName=" ,input$dir_sel, collapse ="")
    req <- GET(url1, authenticate("irt.gen", "irt12345", type="basic"))
    a = content(req, "text")
    resp = fromJSON(a)
    # resp
    dir_list <- strsplit(resp$`DE-managers`, split = ",")
    df <- unlist(dir_list)
    df <- as.data.frame(df)
    colnames(df) <- c("Manager")
    df$info <- "info"
    # df <- data.frame("DE-Manager" = url1)
    df
  }, options = list(pageLength= 5))

UI:

shinyUI(
  htmlTemplate("sample.html")
)

sample.html:

<label>Directors</label>
         <div class = 'select-style styled-select'>
    {{ uiOutput("director_name") }}
</div>

The input i give using selectInput() is not getting stored in the 'id'(dir_sel) that i have given. Hence the table is not getting displayed. Could someone help me with this?
